Name: Cauldron of Chance
Author: WizardsLizards
Description:
A 'small' mod idea, that took me waaaayyyyyyy too long to finish...

[u][b]About this mod:
[/b][/u]This mod lets you unlock the Wizard's Cauldron as a useable object, once you befriend him enough...
Using the Cauldron is as simple as can be - just click on it, to open up a special menu, select 3 items, press 'Ok' and watch the magic happen.
Depending on the Ingredients you threw into the Cauldron a variety of effects can happen. Experiment around and uncover special combinations...
But beware... You never know, what the Wizard himself has added to the Cauldron before you....

(The mod should be pretty balanced, as the effects the Cauldron can produce can be (depending on what you throw into it, daily luck and chance) both advantageous and disadvantageous to you (in limits). But i don't want to spoiler too much... try out & find out! Have fun!! :D)


[b][u]Technical details:[/u][/b]
- Due to the nature of this mod it is hard to really get a feeling for the balance so if you have feedback: please don't be afraid to share it with me ^^
- This mod might have bugs in seldom cases (too many combinations possible to test everything), but it should never crash your game (the only thing it can do is... nothing)
- Should work in Multiplayer
- Should not have any problems with any other Mods (except if that mod also touches the Wizard's Cauldron, but even then it might work)
- A bugfix required me to have the farmer drink a joja cola (internally, you will not see that as the player), when certain effects happen, so any mod that changes what Joja Colas do could also affect this mod.
This will be changed with Stardew Valley 1.6 (or possibly earlier, if i find a solution that doesn't require this mod to add further dependencies to any item frameworks)

Let me know if you find any bugs/problems :>

[u][b]In-depth details:[/b][/u]
I didn't want to add the details about this mod at first, as for me Stardew is all about exploring the unexpected, yet i do understand the wish of others to know more about what a random mod from the internet does, so:

- Unlock requirements:
[spoiler]Visit the Wizard's Tower once you have reached Heartlevel 2 with him. That will trigger an event, after which you can use the Cauldron.[/spoiler]

- Possible effects:
[spoiler]
The most common effects:
[spoiler]
Buff/Debuff: Depending on the ingredients you have added to the Cauldron a random buff/debuff is applied. The strength of the buff/debuff is at maximum 3, with 1 being the most common.

All possible buffs/debuffs are:
[spoiler]
- farming
- fishing
- foraging
- attack
- defense
- maximum stamina (-30, -20, -10, 10, 20, 30)
- luck
- magnetic radius (16, 32, 48) (only as a buff)
- speed
- garlic oil (only as a buff)
- monster musk (only as a debuff)
- debuff immunity (only as a buff)
- the buff a food/drink normally applies (only under certain conditions)
[/spoiler]
[/spoiler]

Special effects that can happen under certain circumstances:
[spoiler]
An item appearing from the cauldron. This can be either due to a special recipe, or an item from a certain combination.
(Recipe: 3 specific items, these can be duplicates)
(Combination: Multiple specific items, these are all distinct from each other)
(A recipe/combination can take effect with at least 2 of the fitting items in the cauldron, yet the chances of that are much smaller than with 3 items)

All possible items are:
[spoiler]
- Golden Pumpkin (recipe)
- Golden Mask (recipe)
- Dwarven Scrolls I-IV (recipe)
- Omni Geode (combination)
- Bones (bone fragment/museum bones) (combination)
[/spoiler]
[/spoiler]

Special effects that can always happen (with a rather small chance):
[spoiler]
Butterflies/Explosion: This effect can always happen (with a very small base chance, that can be modified though).
The butterflies effect spreads a nice smell in the air, increasing your friendship with the Wizard.
The explosion spreads a vile smell in the air, decresing your friendship with the Wizard
[/spoiler]
[/spoiler]
